limitations: This passes the assembled current instruction/integration final gate using existing independent live evidence and separately verified informed repairs. It does not turn the original seven-arm trial into a post-fix live pass. Only original recovery passed its strict arm gate; six report scores remain 7 and creative orchestration remains 7.

There were two code/data pairs and three unpaired creative/recovery/promotion smokes. Both paired arms used installed Sage with an Astra root; eligible worker routing varied. Equal paired scores were equal failed reporting gates. Same invocation counts and treatment outer intervals shorter by 280/98 seconds are case observations, not general equivalence, efficiency or cost savings.

Effective model/effort, normalized token/money data and automatic home discovery remain unobserved. Model-role priors are uncalibrated, and no telemetry is inferred from request labels or synthetic fixture identities.

The same independent critic actor was retained for round 2 and knew E1. The original live workflows also disclosed thread-capacity workarounds, authored journals instead of raw transcripts, a creative unrelated-lifecycle exposure and synthetic promotion source/seed histories. No pristine/blinded claim is made.

Focused and additional recovery sequences are offline scripted public-CLI checks. In particular, the builder's changed-baseline next-action branch is a local scripted decision, not proof that a resumed model will choose it. Manual installed-instruction review establishes the policy connection; future native behavior remains empirically bounded.

Creative evidence remains scoped to original two viewports, keyboard interaction and the measured platform/method. Screen-reader speech, physical touch, runtime reduced-motion and additional platforms are untested.

Helpers validate structure/evidence binding and cooperative transitions; they do not prove authority, persuasive semantic evidence, behavioral independence or physical writer leases. Rollback requires integrity-valid retained history; corrupt-history recovery and crash-atomic multi-file installer behavior are not claimed.

No home installation, browser, network, package install or new live task was performed. No bundled PyYAML-dependent skill-validator pass is claimed. Old supplemental Sage replay provenance remains qualified rather than reconstructed.
